justification: Assessment reported INVALID with flawed step 0016: the safety argument illegitimately treats F(P1C|P2C) as prefix-determined, claiming every extension of sigma[..i] still violates the implication at i. This is exactly the ground-truth flaw. Its counterexample (prefix {P1E,P2E} with repairing extension placing P1C at position 1) is a valid variant of the ground-truth witness ({P1E,P2E}.({P1C})^omega): in both, the extension satisfies F(P1C|P2C) at i=0, so the implication holds and the prefix is not a bad prefix. Same defect, same mechanism.
